For a compressed joint density rho(l,v,p)<=M, the L^(3/2)/Minkowski coarea route produces the exact sufficient cost 2^(1/3)M^(2/3)|lambda|^(-1/3) int int |l|^(-2/3)m(l,p)^(1/3) dl dp, where m=int rho dv.

An explicit cap-one product projection with V=(X1-X2)/sqrt2, P=(X1+X2)/sqrt2 and fragmented supports has joint (L,V,P) density cap exactly one but mixed-Renyi cost (9/2)(1-2^(-1/3))N^(2/3). This refutes only the slice-first certificate mechanism, not QFORM.
